name: com.borderjung.unity-modules
description: Reusable Unity modules by BorderJung, bundled as a single package. Core (build-stripped Log), Events (SO event channels), SaveLoad (JSON), Localization (SO table + ILocalizationProvider), Settings (SO-driven settings + ISettingsRepository), and shared UI.

samples.description: LocalizationTable + LocalizeManager/LocalizeText prefabs. Fonts use LiberationSans SDF.
SettingsSO, event channels, and Settings panel/bool/dropdown/slider + SettingsSystem prefabs. Art stripped to Unity defaults.
Shared UI prefabs: GenericButton, Frame (selection frame). Art stripped to Unity defaults.
